Hello Marnic,
Hope you are doing well.
As we received case from you regarding Mainfan_GQ1 Ok Signal Lost - Fan rotation disabled false, have to carry out following activities for troubleshooting:
1. Check the voltage between L3 and N3, Voltage should be around 230 v.
2. Check for the voltage between 24v1,.3 and Ground, Voltage should be around
3. Check for the loose wiring of the XD7 connector. If it is found to be loose or broken have to be replaced. You check for the spare part at
Sicharge D - Spare Parts Cat. C (sharepoint.com)
4. Check for the continuity from the DI9 pin of KF5 to the 6th Pin of Fan.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0381790-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R3 170001543] Main Fan GQ1 CRM:00642001563
additional_info.body:
Dear
See below:
1.
Check the voltage between L3 and N3, Voltage should be around 230 v.
->
checked was 230V
2. Check for the voltage between 24v1,.3 and Ground, Voltage should be around
->
there is 24V but clamp 6 and 7 on ventilator is open.
3.
Check for the loose wiring of the XD7 connector. If it is found to be loose or broken have to be replaced.
You check for the spare part
-> clamp checked nothing to see here.
4. Check for the continuity from the DI9 pin of KF5 to the 6th Pin of Fan.
->
checked and ok
Status contact on the fan stays open for no reason.
Br.

Dear
Checked all the connections and they seem to be fine. We replaced the fan and the error is gone. So the problem was at the fan.
Problem is solved so ticket can be closed.
Br.
